_compliance_audit_2026_07_10.live_body:
Hi {{name}}, 

Start referring and turn your Zerodha account into rewards 

💰 For every friend who opens an account through you and starts trading, you earn:
1. 10% brokerage share - earn 10% of the brokerage that every eligible referred account generates
2. 300 reward points per account opened. 

Eligibility - at least 3 successful referrals in the past 12 months.

Choose from options how you'd like to refer 👇

Disclosures: gorefer.in/d/pifs
_compliance_audit_2026_07_10.buttons_live: url 'Refer & Earn' -> https://gorefer.in/r/wa/{{client_id}} (dynamic) ; quick_reply 'Share on WhatsApp' ; quick_reply 'Refer directly'
findings: §4.2 — 07_10 DROPPED the inline market-risk warning that 07_09 carried; body now relies only on 'Disclosures: gorefer.in/d/pifs'. Survivable under §4.4 (short-form may relocate disclosures to a linked page, and gorefer.in/d/pifs carries the warning verbatim — confirmed live 2026-07-10) but §4.4 relief is for text that won't fit, and it fit in 07_09. RECOMMENDATION: restore the market-risk line in the NEXT template version; do not re-submit now.

§4.8 — message mentions '10% brokerage share'; gorefer.in/d/pifs is MISSING 'Brokerage will not exceed the SEBI prescribed limit.' ACTION: add that line to the /d/pifs disclosure page (editing the page does NOT trigger a Meta re-approval). ENG/DA task.
§3.2 — Meta approval ≠ NSE/Zerodha approval. PIFS-authored referral content with AP context needs Zerodha written sign-off (referral T&C cl.8.vii) BEFORE broadcast. Confirm before any real send.

§5.5 — '300 reward points + 10% brokerage share' mirrors Zerodha's referral program (ban in abeyance, currently allowed, revocable). Fine while live; this is why §3.2 sign-off matters (Zerodha confirms wording matches live terms).
_compliance_audit_2026_07_10.disclosure_page_verified: gorefer.in/d/pifs live 2026-07-10 — carries §4.1 ID block (Zerodha SEBI INZ000031633 | PIFS | NSE AP AP2516003693) + §4.2 market-risk warning verbatim. §4.8 brokerage-limit line NOT required (Abhay 2026-07-10: '10% brokerage share' is a referral revenue-share to the referrer, not a client brokerage rate; §4.8 targets client rates). Page kept to registration + Zerodha association only.

BUG_disclosure_link.symptom: Tapping the in-body 'Disclosures: gorefer.in/d/pifs' link on WhatsApp -> 'You may not have a proper app for viewing this content'; display mangled to 'gorefer.in/...pifs'.
BUG_disclosure_link.root_cause: URL written scheme-less (no https://). WhatsApp cannot build a proper openable link from a bare domain in BODY TEXT. The /d/pifs page itself is fine (loads over https, web_fetch 200).
BUG_disclosure_link.also_affects: The 'Open here: gorefer.in/r/wa/DA1707' link inside the Share-on-WhatsApp bot reply (same scheme-less pattern). Buttons are unaffected (their URLs carry https://).
BUG_disclosure_link.compliance_impact: NOT cosmetic — this link is the NSE §4.4 hyperlink to the mandated disclosures. Broken link = disclosures unreachable = §4.2/§4.4 basis collapses. MUST fix before any real broadcast.
BUG_disclosure_link.fix: Prepend https:// to every URL that appears as BODY TEXT (templates AND chatbot reply materials). Disclosure link lives in an approved template -> requires a NEW template version + Meta re-approval (bundle the §4.2 market-risk restoration into the same version). Bot-reply links are editable in the Wati dashboard, no Meta approval.
BUG_disclosure_link.verification_pending: Confirm scheme is the cause via a 2-link diagnostic (https vs bare) to the test line within the open 24h window, before spending the Meta re-approval.

chatbot_layer_OPEN_questions: (1) Leads 'Refer & Earn' chatbot: does it actually ask for the Client ID and return the personal link? UNVERIFIED (dashboard-only).

(2) Leads 'Share on WhatsApp' MIS-ATTRIBUTION risk: if it reuses the Share chatbot that hands out gorefer.in/r/wa/DA1707 (Abhay's id), an unknown referrer's shares credit Abhay, not them. Leads Share must capture the referrer's id first.

(3) Hindi keyword routing: Wati keyword-actions match on reply TEXT; Hindi buttons send different text ('सीधे Refer करें','WhatsApp पर शेयर करें') -> need SEPARATE keyword-actions for the Hindi texts or they do nothing.
(4) 'Refer directly' webhook gap UNCHANGED: Direct Zerodha Referral chatbot collects Name/Phone/Email but no POST to /api/wati/webhook, no Zoho lead.

(5) Bot-reply link scheme: template disclosure link fixed to https, but chatbot reply materials (e.g. Share bot 'Open here: gorefer.in/r/wa/DA1707') may still be scheme-less; edited in dashboard, not template.
Resolve via Wati dashboard login (this browser) OR live test sends + reading the conversation via API (needs a human to tap quick-replies).

templates._status: APPROVED (Meta, 2026-07-21, near-instant AUTH algorithmic approval) — submitted on Abhay's explicit go the same day; waTemplateId 27564734539863645; live-verified DELIVERED to the owner's number (terminal status via getMessages, not the ack). Submission recipe that worked: flat payload + buttonsType 'otp' + buttons [{type:'copy_code', parameter:{text:'Copy code', urlType:'none'}}] + addSecurityRecommendation true + includeExpiryTime true + expiresIn 5 + positional customParams. templates.name: gr_platform_gorefer_login_otp_en_2026_07_21
templates.body: {{otp_code}} is your GoRefer login code. For your security, do not share this code.

variables.name: otp_code
variables.meaning: the one-time login code (CSPRNG, generated per issue — always present, no fallback needed)

variables.name: expiry_minutes
variables.meaning: code validity in minutes, derived from the live OTP_CODE_TTL_SECONDS config at send time (always present)

templates._variables_note: NAMED variables per the house standard (never positional {{1}}/{{2}}; owner rule 2026-07-21). Order matters at the Wati send layer: otp_code first, expiry_minutes second — matches apps/otp/adapters.py template_params. Meta's AUTHENTICATION category enforces its own fixed body scaffolding at submit time; the submission skill maps otp_code onto Meta's OTP parameter and expiry_minutes onto the code_expiration_minutes setting.

buttons._note: Meta AUTHENTICATION copy-code button — carries the same {{otp_code}} value as the body; no URL.

templates._compliance_note: AUTHENTICATION templates are exempt from the marketing disclosure block (no promotional content, no incentive claim). Delivery reliability MUST be fixed before OTP depends on this (S2-03 §15 caveat a; historical ~60% send failure is fatal for time-sensitive OTP). Re-confirm the ~₹0.115/msg auth rate at go-live.

variables.name: link
variables._note: FULL link from nudge_link_for() — the canonical builder. NEVER a bare client_id and NEVER a hardcoded URL shape in the body: v3/v4 hardcoded 'gorefer.in/r/{{3}}?s=wa' (legacy M11 query form) and drifted from the canonical channel-path /r/wa/{id} (B1/Q-M-CHANNELPATH). ?s= is only forced for URL BUTTONS, where WhatsApp requires the variable last.
